formula_derivation.acid_graph_construction: Remove mapped dummy map 1, replace its bond to carbonyl C map 2 by a terminal hydroxyl oxygen, sanitize with RDKit, and count implicit hydrogens.
formula_derivation.placeholder_formula_contribution: zero; the PheB1 nitrogen belongs to insulin, not the substituent increment

glucose_stereochemistry.cip_method_note: RDKit documents its legacy CIP implementation as approximate and known to mislabel some centers; validation uses the accurate implementation and a beta-D-glucose reference graph.

1.role: Mapped protein-boundary placeholder for PheB1 N; it is joined to the B1 acyl carbonyl.

2.role: B1 linker carbonyl carbon; amide carbonyl attached to PheB1 N.

4.role: Methylene alpha to the carbonyl; source NMR group OCH2C=O.

5.role: Ether oxygen between the carbonyl-alpha methylene and the ethylene linker.

6.role: First ethylene-linker methylene, adjacent to map 5.

7.role: Second ethylene-linker methylene, adjacent to the glycosidic-side ether oxygen map 8.

8.role: Glycosidic-side ether oxygen linking the ethylene linker to glucose C1.

9.role: Anomeric glucose carbon; beta-D glycosidic attachment site.

10.role: Glucopyranose ring oxygen between glucose C5 and C1.

11.role: Glucose C2 stereocenter bearing a free hydroxyl at map 12.

12.role: Free hydroxyl oxygen at glucose C2.

13.role: Glucose C3 stereocenter bearing a free hydroxyl at map 14.

14.role: Free hydroxyl oxygen at glucose C3.

15.role: Glucose C4 stereocenter bearing a free hydroxyl at map 16.

16.role: Free hydroxyl oxygen at glucose C4.

17.role: Glucose C5 stereocenter; bears the C6 hydroxymethyl substituent and ring oxygen map 10.

19.role: Free hydroxyl oxygen at glucose C6.

digestion_and_redox_assumptions: Trypsin cleavage after ArgB22 gives a free B1 N terminus and a free B22 carboxyl terminus.
Peptide formula is the sum of neutral amino-acid formulae minus H2O for each of 21 peptide bonds.
TCEP-reduced cysteines are modeled as separate thiols; no disulfide subtraction is applied to this isolated fragment.
The B1 glycoside adds net C10H16O8 after amide condensation.

monoisotopic_mass_convention.calculation: (neutral monoisotopic mass + 2 × proton mass) / 2; proton mass is used directly, without an electron-mass correction

limits: The corrected candidate coordinates are derivatives of publisher-supplied author models, not experimentally resolved NNC2215 structures.
PDB LINK and CONECT records establish adjacency only; this audit does not infer their bond order, formal charge, or stereochemistry.
Source bond classes are annotations transferred after exact graph mapping. Heuristic distance intervals are a geometry screen only and do not choose mappings.
PheB1 backbone atoms beyond the N boundary endpoint are outside the B1 attachment component graph.
The B1–B22 mass check is a fragment-composition benchmark under stated cleavage/reduction assumptions; it does not prove atom-by-atom coordinates.
Physiological protonation, full-conjugate graph, formal charges, custom force-field parameters, and simulation stability remain unvalidated.
No target-binding molecular dynamics readiness is established by this B1 topology audit.
